inputs.input_path: Required path to a media file or an existing SRT file.
inputs.output_path: Optional explicit subtitle output path; media-file outputs default to a same-directory <video-basename>.<lang>.srt copy.
inputs.execution_mode: Optional MCP or CLI preference; the selected path must use the skill's deterministic orchestration and runtime contracts.
inputs.ffmpeg_path: User-owned FFmpeg/ffprobe binary directory when the tools are not discoverable on PATH.
inputs.opensubtitles_credentials: User-owned OpenSubtitles API key, username, and password supplied only to the login flow when authentication is required.
inputs.batch_scope: Optional folder, season, or library scope for queue-driven processing.

outputs.final_subtitle: A structurally valid SRT with source cue order and timestamps preserved.
outputs.media_sidecar_subtitle: For media inputs, a copy named <original-video-basename>.<lang>.srt beside the source video unless the user requests another destination.
outputs.batch_state: For multi-file runs, centralized queue, completion, failure, in-progress, and run-note files under the configured temp root.
outputs.run_summary: Source selection, translation outcome, output paths, and per-item success or failure details.

default_assumptions.execution_authority: Loom Skill Orchestrator is the only official skill workflow authority; the subtitle CLI and MCP are execution primitives behind explicit workflow seams.
default_assumptions.embedded_track_fallback: If no usable embedded track exists, continue to local subtitle discovery and then OpenSubtitles instead of terminating the batch.
default_assumptions.opensubtitles_search_download: Search and download remain strictly serial; after rate limiting, use delayed serial retries and preserve the remaining queue.
default_assumptions.authentication: OpenSubtitles credentials are managed through login/aquire/status/clear cache commands; secrets are never placed in per-call workflow parameters or persisted outputs.
default_assumptions.translation: Translate in grouped rolling-context batches while preserving cue segmentation, timing, ordering, and identifiers.
default_assumptions.structural_validation: Stop on malformed SRT output; do not merge or split cues unless the user explicitly requests it.
default_assumptions.batch_state: Keep queue state in centralized temporary storage, never beside media files; process each item through the same single-item subtitle pipeline.
default_assumptions.subtitle_runtime: The subtitle CLI is binary-free in the skill package and is restored as an exact host-RID NativeAOT package independently of the SO workflow runtime.
default_assumptions.loom_runtime: Use the exact SO runtime version and product/RID package in assets/so-workflow/so-package-lock.json; do not float to latest or confuse it with the subtitle CLI package.
default_assumptions.workflow_source: The checked-in SO workflow JSON is the source template; official run/resume operations use a fresh external workflow copy and keep all audit/runtime files outside the skill folder.
